headline: Sox cruise to a monster win against the Dodgers in LA
morning_brew: I was braced for a long night of travel-fatigue misery, but the Sox decided to make mincemeat out of the Dodgers instead. Ceddanne Rafaela looked like he was playing against his younger cousins in the backyard, driving in two runs and launching a bomb to help us hang nine on the board. When the top of the order brings that kind of heat, the whole dugout carries themselves like they own the place, and honestly, it is beautiful to watch.

Ranger Suarez had me sweating through my shirt with a shaky start, but Brayan Bello came out of the pen and threw four massive scoreless innings to stop the bleeding. Seeing him lock it down like that kept the Dodgers from ever really feeling like they had a pulse. My neighbor Rick is already whispering that the team is peaking, and for the first time in his life, I am not gonna tell him he is a complete lunatic.

We are riding high on a three-game winning streak and the clubhouse vibes are finally hitting right. We have another date with the Dodgers tonight, and if we keep this momentum rolling, there is no reason we can't take this series. I am dropping another deposit in the Duck Boat fund, grabbing a large at Dunks, and bracing for first pitch like it is the World Series.
